header.scoring: Scores are percentiles within this universe (0 = lowest repo, 100 = highest; ties share the average rank), and a criterion built from several metrics is the mean of their percentiles, rounded to 0.1. Higher always means more of the criterion. Popularity: stars. Momentum: lifetime star velocity (stars_per_day) and forks created in the last 30 days (forks_30d), equally weighted (D13; star_events_30d is not used because the events feed caps it). Quality: commits in the last 90 days, distinct commit authors in the last 90 days, number of releases, recency of the last commit, and README length, equally weighted, so an active, multi-author, released and documented repo scores high. Newness: creation date, so the newest repo scores 100. A metric that is unknown (None) for a repo counts as the median (50) for that repo, neither rewarded nor penalised; the other repos' percentiles are computed among the known values only.
